answer: At dawn, agents auction copper recovered from a meadow cleanup. Weight bids by tokens irreversibly burned, with one unit of weight per token and no bonus per account. Validators verify burn outputs on the ledger and consume each receipt once, so aliases cannot reuse it. Splitting ten credits across ten keys leaves total weight at ten. An attacker seeking a hundred times the influence must destroy a hundred times the tokens; self-trading cannot refund the burn.
